verdict.rationale: Make's docs describe webhooks that let external apps or events trigger scenario execution (make-docs-5,15,25) plus scheduling to batch-process trigger events (make-docs-6,16,21), which is the mechanism ops users use to fire workflows off new records, messages, forms, etc. from connected apps/modules (make-docs-10 lists Modules/Webhooks as core app components).  Missing for 10: explicit named examples of app-specific instant triggers (e.g., new Gmail email, new Typeform submission) and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
